verdict: the installed generic A4 twist has a K_A4-rational point

invariant_field.transcendence_basis: with ell=A2/A0 and m=A1/A0, u=ell^3 and v=ell*m

constant_data.cyclotomic_field: Q(t)/(Phi_33(t)), zeta_11=t^3, omega=t^11, embedded in C
constant_data.landing_constants: (p1,p2,p3) is any C-zero of the exact proper ideal in degree3_character1_exact_chart0.sing with p0=1
constant_data.existence_reason: proper ideal plus algebraic closedness of C

installed_source_intertwiner.identity: P*sigma_can(h)=sigma_inst(h)*P for all h in A4

point_coordinates: Z_K(y)=(M/(S*x*y*z))*A_inst(P*y)^(-1)*Phi(y), with S=x^2+y^2+z^2 and M=x^2+omega^2*y^2+omega*z^2; the point is [Z_K0:...:Z_K4]
membership_in_K: A_inst(P*g*y)^(-1)*Phi(g*y)=chi(g)*A_inst(P*y)^(-1)*Phi(y); M/S has inverse character and 1/(x*y*z) corrects degree 3, so every Z_Ki is a degree-zero A4-invariant in C(u,v)
equivalent_homogeneous_formula: with D=product_h ell(sigma_inst(h^-1)P*y), B_clr=D*A_inst(P*y), N=adj(B_clr)*Phi, the same projective point is [N] and B_clr*N=det(B_clr)*Phi
nonvanishing: every denominator is a nonzero rational function and Phi is nonzero because p0=1 in a linearly independent covariant basis
scope: closes the A4 subgroup obstruction only; makes no full PSL(2,F_11) verdict
